description: This PHP source file defines the 'Holiday' entity class for the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes properties and methods related to holiday details such as ID, name, date, length, recurring status, and associated operational country, using Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday, with properties like id, name, date, length, recurring status, and operational country, utilizing Doctrine ORM for persistence and supporting decorator pattern.
